Plot a Genetic Linkage Map

Source: R/linkMap.cross.R
linkMap.cross.Rd

Produces a clean ggplot2 visualisation of a genetic linkage map using frameless facets – one column per chromosome – with a shared reversed cM y-axis (0 cM at the top). Chromosome bars are rendered as narrow pill shapes. Marker labels are placed with ggrepel to avoid overprinting even on dense maps. Returns a ggplot object so additional layers (e.g. QTL regions from linkMap.qtlAim) can be composed with +.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cross'
linkMap(
  object,
  chr,
  chr.dist,
  marker.names = "markers",
  tick = FALSE,
  squash = TRUE,
  m.cex = 7,
  nrow = 1,
  row.chr = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A "cross" object produced by read.cross or primeCross.

chr

Optional character vector of chromosome names to display. Defaults to all chromosomes.

chr.dist

Optional named list with elements $start and/or $end (scalar or per-chromosome numeric vectors of cM positions) restricting the displayed map range.

marker.names

Character string controlling marker label display. "markers" (default): marker names; "dist": cM positions; "none" or NULL: no labels (best for dense maps); "flanking": only markers listed in attr(object, "flanking") (set automatically by linkMap.qtlAim).

tick

Logical. Unused; retained for back-compatibility.

squash

Logical. Unused; retained for back-compatibility.

m.cex

Numeric. Text size (pt) for marker labels. Default 7.

nrow

Integer or "auto". Number of rows in the facet layout. 1 (default) gives the standard single-row display. "auto" chooses ceiling(n_chr / 8) automatically. Ignored when row.chr is supplied.

row.chr

Optional named or unnamed list of character vectors, one element per row. Each vector names the chromosomes to display in that row, in left-to-right order. When supplied, it overrides both chr and nrow: only chromosomes present in row.chr are shown, and the facet layout is set to length(row.chr) rows by max(lengths(row.chr)) columns. Chromosomes absent from the map are silently dropped; rows that contain fewer chromosomes than the widest row are right-padded with blank panels.

...

Additional arguments passed to ggrepel::geom_text_repel.

Value

A ggplot object.
